summary: Core AI Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: CHAI), a British Columbia foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt on September 18, 2026 of a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications deficiency notice for failing the $2,500,000 minimum stockholders' equity standard under Listing Rule 5550(b)(1); unaudited equity as of June 30, 2026 was $2,429,389 — a shortfall of roughly $70,611. The company must submit a compliance plan by November 2, 2026, a 45-day window; a plan can be granted up to 180 days, potentially to mid-2027. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or premium is stated. Watch dilution risk from a remedial equity raise and potential Nasdaq extension or delisting determination.
